author: goblirsc
body:
Update the Millepede alignment package family to the latest tags. 

Relevant changes include: 
- bugfix to Millepede: Fixed inconsistent outlier weight treatment in the fit. 
- Fix to a race condition when reading alignment binaries with `closeandreopen` configuration on many threads 
- Fix to composed trajectory initialisation in GBL
- Mille writing is now thread-safe, several threads can concurrently populate the same binary. 
- Many fixes and cleanups to the CMake build setup - removed need to hack files in-place during the GBL build.
- Numerous compiler warnings fixed

The outlier weight bugfix changes the alignment results and requires an update to `CMSSW` to load the corresponding updated reference alignment tag within the alignment CI tests.
title: Update Millepede packages (GBL, Mille and Millepede-II) to latest tags
